title: Data-Void Exploits in Web-Searching LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.30365v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Web-searching Large Language Models (LLMs) have changed how users seek online information: instead of sifting through ranked lists of links, users read synthesized answers. This shift creates a new LLM vulnerability: a data-void exploit. Disinformers publish their narratives in search spaces where relevant and reliable content is scarce, i.e. data voids, then rely on the LLM's web-search to retrieve and then use, cite, or list those pages in its responses to data-void seeking prompts. Unlike classical search, where users see ranking cues and competing results, LLMs can obscure when an answer relies on sparse, unverified, or adversarial sources. We study this threat by varying the user's prompt tone - skeptical, excited, or neutral - and LLM choice - ChatGPT, Gemini, or Sonar Pro - as well as three attacker controls. translated_title: 网络搜索型大语言模型中的数据空洞漏洞利用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.30365v1 公告类型：交叉发布。摘要：具备网络搜索功能的大语言模型（LLM）改变了用户在线获取信息的方式：用户不再逐条浏览排好序的链接列表，而是直接阅读模型综合生成的答案。这一转变催生了一种新的LLM漏洞：数据空洞（data-void）漏洞利用。虚假信息散布者将他们的叙事内容发布到相关且可靠内容稀缺的搜索空间（即“数据空洞”）中，然后依赖LLM的网络搜索功能检索这些页面，并在响应用户针对数据空洞的提问时使用、引用或列出这些页面。与传统搜索不同（用户可以看到排名提示和相互竞争的搜索结果），LLM可能掩盖其答案依赖于稀疏、未经验证或对抗性来源的事实。我们通过改变用户提示的语气——怀疑、兴奋或中性——以及LLM的选择——ChatGPT、Gemini或Sonar Pro——再加上攻击者的三种控制手段来研究这一威胁。攻击者可以使用五种已知策略之一来构建并填充数据空洞以植入其叙事内容，并托管其受控的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了一种针对网络搜索型大语言模型的新攻击方式——“数据空洞”漏洞利用：虚假信息散布者在可靠内容稀缺的搜索空间中植入叙事内容，诱导LLM在回答提问时检索并引用这些不可靠来源，并通过实验考察了提示语气、模型选择和攻击者控制手段对攻击效果的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a novel attack on web-searching LLMs called data-void exploits, where disinformers plant narratives in search spaces lacking reliable content to induce LLMs to retrieve and cite unverified sources in their answers, and experimentally examines how prompt tone, model choice, and attacker controls affect the attack's effectiveness.
